parameter_description: Send a Program Change on MIDI channel 1 to recall a Scene
notes: Program Change 0-99 on MIDI channel 1 recalls Scene 0-99. Requires Setup > Remote > MIDI In/Out enabled and Enable MIDI Scene Recall. Verify against your firmware version
